{{Top|leg}}
A '''city-state''' was a sovereign state consisting of an autonomous [[City/Legends|city]]. Before the rise of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jafan/Legends|Jafan]] and the second foundation of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|inhabitants]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] were divided into a number of warring city-states.<ref name="OSVC36">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 36|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 36]]</ref> The planet [[Lazerian IV]] had a city-state&mdash;[[Doxeti]]&mdash;on its surface as well, which was a quasi-independent city-state that often deferred to the planet's [[Kingdom of Devit|primary government]]. The [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Akwin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] resided in multiple cities on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor of Lazerian IV, each of which was its own city-state ruled by a king or queen.<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
